S.FORM: magal kanailil icami ka matuuwal (masiqun kakawsa) san ku magal kanailil. kiya ku magal kanailil yi tinqalangang niyam iwan na rahuwal na uwawu qutux naniqan kaxbarg. imuwag naku makurakis/marakiyas sumilma cu qasinu ru quwawu na turakis sipaqaneq cu rumaruma, makurakis/marakiyas bali nanak ku magawp mapa-iyu uwi cu qaraqarax ka sasilhu inlungang. pasibaqan cu kai naku malhow, sasilawkahan naku rawirawing ku inha.
S.PHON: maɣal kanailil i[ʦ|ʨ]ami ka matuuwal ma[s|ɕ]iqun kakaw[s|ɕ]a [s|ɕ]an ku maɣal kanailil kija ku maɣal kanailil ji tinqalaŋaŋ nijam iwan na raħuwal na uwawu qutux naniqan kaxβarɣ imuwaɣ naku makuraki[s|ɕ]marakija[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]umilma [ʦ|ʨ]u qa[s|ɕ]inu ru quwawu na turaki[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]ipaqaneq [ʦ|ʨ]u rumaruma makuraki[s|ɕ]marakija[s|ɕ] βali nanak ku maɣawp mapaiju uwi [ʦ|ʨ]u qaraqarax ka [s|ɕ]a[s|ɕ]ilħu inluŋaŋ pa[s|ɕ]iβaqan [ʦ|ʨ]u kai naku malħow [s|ɕ]a[s|ɕ]ilawkaħan naku rawirawiŋ ku inħa
